settings.title: Long-staple Fibres
settings.body: We source yarns chosen for staple length — the longer the fibre, the softer and more durable the knit. No shortcuts in the raw material.

settings.title: True Gauge Knitting
settings.body: Every style is knit at the gauge it was designed for. The right machine, the right stitch count. Your knitwear holds its shape.

settings.title: Hand Finished
settings.body: Every seam is linked by hand. Every piece inspected before it ships. Not a robot. A person who cares about the result.

settings.title: Pre-washed
settings.body: All garments are pre-washed before leaving our floor. What you receive is the finished size. No unpleasant surprises.

settings.hero_heading: What we put into every piece.
settings.intro: We are a factory first. Every piece we sell carries fifteen years of manufacturing knowledge — the same standards we applied to global brands, now applied to your wardrobe.
